definitions.explanation: At some point in the future, whether soon or after some time. Implies that the outcome is inevitable.

examples.japanese: {早晩|そうばん}{問題|もんだい}になるだろう。
examples.english: It will become a problem sooner or later.

examples.japanese: この{状況|じょうきょう}は{早晩|そうばん}{行|い}き{詰|づ}まるに{違|ちが}いない。
examples.english: This situation is bound to reach a dead end sooner or later.

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}の{進歩|しんぽ}により、この{仕事|しごと}は{早晩|そうばん}なくなると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that due to advances in technology, this job will eventually disappear.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-style adverb. Literally combines {早|はや}い (early) and {晩|おそ}い (late), meaning "whether early or late." Used to express that something is inevitable regardless of timing. More literary than いずれ or そのうち.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いずれ: eventually, someday (slightly more common)
- そのうち: sooner or later, one of these days (conversational)
- {遅|おそ}かれ{早|はや}かれ: sooner or later (set phrase)

cross_references.label: sooner or later, one of these days
